newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria 4.2 bln lev coupon T-bill issue sold out.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria 4.2 bln lev coupon T-bill issue sold out.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry special issue of 4.2 billion levs worth of 49-day floater coupon T-bills was sold out, yielding 207.06 percent, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said.
The issue was erroneously offered as a discount one in a central bank statement late on Tuesday, a BNB official told Reuters.

The issue was offered with no minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry and its coupon equals the BNB's central interest rate (CIR) for the period to maturity. The CIR is now set at an annual 108 percent.
Settlement for the auction was made on Wednesday at the average accepted price, the BNB said.
The central bank and three other financial institutions took part in the auction.
The paper was issued along with nine other issues, all dated September 4, to cover maturity payments of around 24.3 billion levs on three treasury issues, a finance ministry official said.
Avg price of bids 98.49 pct of par
